t2.title: Social media companies be responsible for the content users post
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should social media companies be responsible for the content users post?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Social media platforms have transformed how we communicate, but they have also become sources of harmful content. I believe these companies should bear greater responsibility for what appears on their platforms.

Firstly, social media companies profit from user engagement, including engagement with controversial content. It is only fair that they also accept responsibility for the negative consequences. Misinformation, hate speech, and cyberbullying can cause real harm to individuals and society.

Secondly, these platforms have the technological capability to monitor and remove harmful content. Advanced algorithms already detect copyright violations, so similar technology could identify dangerous material.

However, some argue this threatens free speech. While freedom of expression is important, it should not protect content that harms others. There is a difference between opinion and deliberate misinformation.

Furthermore, government regulations could establish clear standards while protecting legitimate speech.

In conclusion, social media companies must take responsibility for content moderation. With great power comes great responsibility.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi FreshBite!

Food good. I like chicken.
More fruit please.
Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello FreshBite,

t2.sampleB1:
Dear FreshBite Team,

I'm writing to give you some feedback on the meal delivery service. Overall, I'm happy with the food. The variety is good, and I like trying new things. However, I think the portion sizes could be a bit bigger, especially for dinner. I'm often still a little hungry afterwards.

The delivery timing is usually convenient, but there have been a couple of times when it was late. It would be helpful to have a more precise delivery window.

As for dietary options, I'd like to see more vegetarian meals. Also, some low-carb options would be great. Thanks for asking for my opinion!

Sincerely,

Sabina Salimova
t2.sampleB2: Who Should Clean Up the Internet? Every day, billions of us scroll through social media, yet few of us stop to ask who is responsible when things go wrong. Should the companies behind these platforms answer for the content their users post? In my opinion, they absolutely should. To begin with, these firms make enormous profits from the very content people share. If they are happy to cash in on our posts, it is only fair that they take responsibility for harmful material such as hate speech, fake news and online bullying, which can cause real damage to vulnerable people. What is more, they already have the tools to act. Clever algorithms can spot copyright breaches in seconds, so removing dangerous content is well within their reach. Of course, some people worry that this could stifle free speech. However, there is a clear line between sharing an honest opinion and spreading lies that put others at risk. All things considered, social media giants cannot simply wash their hands of the problem. By keeping their platforms safe, they would earn our trust and make the online world a better place for everyone.
t2.uzSample:
Ijtimoiy media platformalari bizning muloqot qilish usulimizni o'zgartirdi, lekin ular zararli kontent manbaiga ham aylandilar. Menimcha, bu kompaniyalar o'z platformalarida paydo bo'ladigan narsalar uchun katta mas'uliyatni o'z zimmalariga olishlari kerak.

Birinchidan, ijtimoiy media kompaniyalari foydalanuvchilarning jalb qilinishidan, shu jumladan bahsli kontent bilan jalb qilinishidan foyda ko'radilar. Salbiy oqibatlar uchun ham mas'uliyatni o'z zimmalariga olishlari adolatdan bo'ladi. Noto'g'ri ma'lumot, nafrat nutqi va kiberbulling shaxslarga va jamiyatga haqiqiy zarar etkazishi mumkin.

Ikkinchidan, ushbu platformalar zararli kontentni kuzatish va olib tashlash uchun texnologik imkoniyatga ega. Murakkab algoritmlar allaqachon mualliflik huquqini buzilishini aniqlaydi, shuning uchun shunga o'xshash texnologiya xavfli materialni aniqlashi mumkin.

Biroq, ba'zilarning ta'kidlashicha, bu so'z erkinligiga tahdid soladi. Ifoda erkinligi muhim bo'lsa-da, u boshqalarga zarar etkazadigan kontentni himoya qilmasligi kerak. Fikr va ataylab noto'g'ri ma'lumot o'rtasida farq bor.

Bundan tashqari, hukumat qoidalari qonuniy nutqni himoya qilgan holda aniq standartlarni o'rnatishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, ijtimoiy media kompaniyalari kontentni moderatsiya qilish uchun mas'uliyatni o'z zimmalariga olishlari kerak. Katta kuch bilan katta mas'uliyat keladi.

Hurmatli FreshBite jamoasi,

Men sizga taom yetkazib berish xizmati haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, ovqatdan mamnunman. Xilma-xillik yaxshi va menga yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rish yoqadi. Biroq, menimcha, porsiya hajmi biroz kattaroq bo'lishi mumkin, ayniqsa kechki ovqat uchun. Ko'pincha keyin ham biroz och qolaman.

Yetkazib berish vaqti odatda qulay, ammo bir necha marta kechikkan holatlar bo'lgan. Aniqroq yetkazib berish vaqtini belgilash foydali bo'lardi.

Dietik variantlarga kelsak, men ko'proq vegetarian taomlarni ko'rishni xohlardim. Shuningdek, kam uglevodli variantlar ham ajoyib bo'lardi. Fikrimni so'raganingiz uchun rahmat!

Hurmat bilan,

Sabina Salimova
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli FreshBite jamoasi,

Men sizning ovqat yetkazib berish xizmatidan foydalanish tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, men ovqatlarning sifati va yangiligidan juda mamnunman. Xilma-xillik maqtovga loyiq, turli xil oshxonalar va ingredientlarni taklif etadi. Biroq, menda yaxshilash uchun bir nechta takliflar bor.

Portsiya hajmi tushlik uchun yetarli bo'lsa-da, men ularni kechki ovqat uchun, ayniqsa, jismoniy faollik bilan shug'ullangan kunlarimda biroz yetarli emas deb bilaman. Ehtimol, kattaroq portsiya variantini, hatto qo'shimcha to'lov evaziga taklif qilish foydali bo'lar edi.

Yetkazib berishga kelsak, vaqt odatda qulay, garchi ba'zida kechikishlar bo'lgan. Batafsilroq kuzatuv tizimi yoki potentsial kechikishlar haqida oldindan xabar berish mijozlar tajribasini yaxshilaydi.

Dietik variantlar nuqtai nazaridan, men vegetarian taomlariga ko'proq o'simlik asosidagi protein manbalarini, masalan, yasmiq yoki loviyani kiritilishini xohlardim. Bundan tashqari, minimal darajada qayta ishlangan oziq-ovqatlar va butun donlarga e'tibor qaratgan maxsus "toza ovqatlanish" menyusining joriy etilishi sog'lig'iga e'tiborli iste'molchilarning o'sib borayotgan segmentiga xizmat qiladi.

Fikr-mulohazalarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur. Ishonamanki, bu o'zgartirishlar FreshBite xizmatini yanada yuqori darajaga ko'taradi.

Hurmat bilan,

Sabina Salimova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the meal delivery service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear FreshBite Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your meal delivery service. I have been thoroughly impressed with the quality of your meals. The portion sizes are generous and the food is consistently delicious. I particularly appreciate the calorie information provided with each meal. However, I have some suggestions for improvement. The delivery window is quite wide, making it difficult to plan my day. A more specific time slot option would be greatly appreciated. Additionally, the packaging uses too much plastic, which concerns me environmentally. I would love to see more vegetarian options and perhaps a low-carb meal plan for customers following specific diets. International cuisine options would also add variety. Overall, FreshBite has significantly improved my eating habits. Yours sincerely, Sabina Salimova

Hi FreshBite,
Food is good. I like chicken.
More fruit please. Delivery okay.
Bye

t12.sampleB1:
Dear FreshBite Team,

Thank you for your email. I want to tell you what I think about your meal delivery service.

I think the meals are usually very good, and I like the variety. However, sometimes the food is a little bit cold when it arrives. The portion sizes are good for me. Also, the delivery time is usually convenient.

I would like to see more vegetarian meals on the menu. For example, maybe you could add a vegetarian curry. I also think it would be good to have more information about the ingredients in each meal.

Thank you for listening to my suggestions.

Sincerely,
Sabina Salimova
t12.sampleB2: Dear FreshBite Team, Thank you for taking the time to ask for my feedback. Having used your service for the past month, I am delighted to share my thoughts. On the whole, I am very impressed with the quality of your meals. The variety is excellent, and the ingredients always taste fresh. The portion sizes are just right for lunch, though I find them slightly small at dinner. As for delivery, the timing suits my schedule perfectly. That said, I would love to see a few new options on the menu. More plant-based dishes would be a welcome addition, and a low-carb plan would appeal to those watching their weight. It would also be great if you could cut down on the plastic packaging. Keep up the good work! Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev

Hurmatli FreshBite jamoasi,

Ovqat yetkazib berish xizmatingiz haqidagi tajribam bilan qiziqqaningiz uchun rahmat.

Men sizning taomlaringiz sifati bilan juda hayratlandim. Porsiya hajmlari katta va ovqat doimiy ravishda mazali. Har bir taom bilan taqdim etilgan kaloriya ma'lumotini ayniqsa qadrlayman.

Biroq, takliflarim bor. Yetkazib berish vaqti oralig'i juda keng, bu esa kunimni rejalashtirishni qiyinlashtiradi. Aniqroq vaqt oralig'i varianti juda minnatdorchilik bilan qabul qilinadi. Bundan tashqari, qadoqlashda juda ko'p plastik ishlatiladi, bu meni ekologik jihatdan xavotirga soladi.

Men ko'proq vegetarian taomlarini va ehtimol, muayyan parhezga rioya qiladigan mijozlar uchun kam uglevodli taom rejasini ko'rishni istardim. Xalqaro oshxona variantlari ham xilma-xillik qo'shadi.

Umuman olganda, FreshBite mening ovqatlanish odatlarimni sezilarli darajada yaxshiladi.

Hurmat bilan,
Sabina Salimova

Hurmatli FreshBite jamoasi,

Menimcha, ovqatlar odatda juda yaxshi va menga xilma-xilligi yoqadi. Biroq, ba'zida ovqat yetib kelganda biroz sovuq bo'ladi. Porsiya hajmi men uchun yaxshi. Shuningdek, yetkazib berish vaqti odatda qulay.

Men menyuda ko'proq vegetarian taomlarni ko'rishni xohlardim. Misol uchun, ehtimol siz vegetarian karrini qo'shishingiz mumkin. Shuningdek, har bir taom tarkibidagi ingredientlar haqida ko'proq ma'lumotga ega bo'lish yaxshi bo'lardi deb o'ylayman.

Hurmatli FreshBite jamoasi,

Ovqat yetkazib berish xizmatingiz haqida fikr-mulohazalarni to‘plash uchun murojaat qilganingiz uchun rahmat. Men bir necha haftadan beri obunachiman va o‘z fikrlarimni bo‘lishmoqchiman.

Umuman olganda, men ovqatlarning sifatidan juda mamnunman. Mahsulotlarning yangiligi sezilarli va men sog‘lom variantlarga e’tibor qaratilganini qadrlayman. Porsiya hajmi yetarli, garchi ba’zida ular biroz nomuvofiqdek tuyuladi. Yetkazib berish vaqti odatda qulay, lekin o‘tgan hafta bir marta kechikish bo‘ldi.

Takliflar nuqtai nazaridan, men ingredientlaringizning manbalari haqida ko‘proq shaffoflikni xohlardim. Mahsulotlar va go‘sht qayerdan kelayotganini bilish juda muhim afzallik bo‘lardi. Bundan tashqari, vegan variantlaringizni kengaytirish mijozlarning kengroq bazasini qamrab olishiga ishonaman. Ehtimol, siz individual parhez ehtiyojlari va afzalliklarini qondirish uchun moslashtirilgan ovqat rejalashtirishni ham ko‘rib chiqishingiz mumkin. Nihoyat, qadoqlash funksional, lekin u yanada ekologik toza bo‘lishi mumkinmi?

Umuman olganda, FreshBite - bu menga sog‘lom ovqatlanishni saqlashga yordam bergan qimmatli xizmat. Umid qilamanki, mening fikrlarim foydali bo‘ladi.

Hurmat bilan,
Sabina Salimova
